findings.summary: Implementer's report states 'Tests for the change were written and run,' but the diff contains no test file changes, and the repo has no test runner at all (no vitest/playwright config, no test script in apps/web/package.json — only dev/build/preview/typecheck/lint; a repo-wide search for *.test.*/*.spec.* returns nothing). The claim cannot correspond to any artifact in this change and should not be taken at face value.
